evals.title: Init then build
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is true.
- `mkdocs-material` is installed.
- The workspace is scaffolded.]

Build the documentation website.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills site init`. - Name `python -m skore_skills site build`. - Name `html/index.html` as the file to open. It must NOT: - Run `notebook convert`. - Run `git commit`. - Load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` or `nbclient`.
expectations: Name `html/index.html` as the file to open.
The response does NOT: Run `notebook convert`.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit`.
The response does NOT: Load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` or `nbclient`.

evals.title: Later turns only build
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is true.
- `site init` already ran.]

Rebuild the site.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills site build`. - Do not run `site init` again. - Name `html/index.html` as the file to open. It must NOT: - AskUserQuestion for the site gate again. - Run `notebook convert`. - Run `git end-turn`.
expectations: Name `html/index.html` as the file to open.
The response does NOT: AskUserQuestion for the site gate again.
The response does NOT: Run `notebook convert`.
The response does NOT: Run `git end-turn`.

evals.title: Gate off
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is false.]

Build the MkDocs site.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Say the documentation-site gate is off and offer to turn it on. It must NOT: - Run `site init` or `site build` while the flag is false.
expectations: Say the documentation-site gate is off and offer to turn it on.
The response does NOT: Run `site init` or `site build` while the flag is false.

evals.title: Null gate installs mkdocs only
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is null.
- `add-python-package` is installed.]

Build the documentation website.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - AskUserQuestion documentation site (default off). - If the user says yes: persist `site true`, load `add-python-package` for `mkdocs-material`, then init and build. It must NOT: - Install `jupytext`, `nbclient`, or `nbconvert` for the site gate. - Convert while only turning the site on.
expectations: If the user says yes: persist `site true`, load `add-python-package` for `mkdocs-material`, then init and build.
The response does NOT: Install `jupytext`, `nbclient`, or `nbconvert` for the site gate.
The response does NOT: Convert while only turning the site on.
